name.zh: 20 号高速公路（Autoroute Jean-Lesage，让·勒萨日高速公路）

tagline.en: Three official names, two separate pieces, and the road the province signed for last
tagline.zh: 三个官方名称、两段互不相连的路身，也是该省最后才签约的那条路

start.en: The Ontario boundary at Rivière-Beaudette, where Ontario's Highway 401 becomes Autoroute 20
start.zh: Rivière-Beaudette 的安大略省界，安大略 401 号公路在此变为 20 号高速公路

end.en: Notre-Dame-des-Neiges, in Bas-Saint-Laurent, where the autoroute stops; a second section resumes about 100 km further on between Rimouski and Mont-Joli
end.zh: 下圣劳伦斯地区的 Notre-Dame-des-Neiges，高速公路在此中断；约 100 公里之后，Rimouski 与 Mont-Joli 之间另有一段

en: Autoroute 20 runs along the south shore of the St. Lawrence from the Ontario border to the lower river, and it is the busiest road in Quebec outside Montreal's own network. It crosses 67 municipalities, carries the Trans-Canada designation for most of its length, and is one of the two autoroutes — with A-40 on the north shore — on which almost all road traffic between Montreal and Quebec City moves.

It also carries three official names at once, all of them conferred by the Commission de toponymie. Most of the route is the Autoroute Jean-Lesage, after Quebec's nineteenth premier and the architect of the Quiet Revolution. The stretch from Rivière-Beaudette to the Turcot interchange in Montreal is the Autoroute du Souvenir, named on the sixtieth anniversary of the end of the Second World War for those who died in it. North of the Champlain Bridge it overlaps the Autoroute René-Lévesque.

The Commission's own record states plainly that the autoroute is built in two distinct sections. The main one ends at Notre-Dame-des-Neiges; the second picks up about a hundred kilometres further east between Rimouski and Mont-Joli. The gap has never been built to autoroute standard, and Route 132 carries the traffic through it.
zh: 20 号高速公路沿圣劳伦斯河南岸自安大略省界通往下游河段，是蒙特利尔本地路网之外魁北克最繁忙的道路。它穿过 67 个市镇，大部分路段承载横加公路的指定，并与北岸的 40 号高速公路一道，承担了蒙特利尔与魁北克城之间几乎全部的公路交通。

它同时拥有三个官方名称，均由 Commission de toponymie（地名委员会）颁定。主体路段名为 Autoroute Jean-Lesage（让·勒萨日高速公路），纪念魁北克第十九任省长、「宁静革命」的缔造者。自 Rivière-Beaudette 至蒙特利尔 Turcot 立交的一段名为 Autoroute du Souvenir（纪念高速公路），命名于第二次世界大战结束六十周年之际，纪念阵亡者。在尚普兰桥以北，它又与 Autoroute René-Lévesque（勒内·勒维克高速公路）重合。
地名委员会的记录明确写道，这条高速公路由两段彼此分开的路身构成。主段止于 Notre-Dame-des-Neiges；第二段在约一百公里之外的 Rimouski 与 Mont-Joli 之间重新开始。中间的缺口从未按高速公路标准建成，其交通由 132 号公路承担。

en: Quebec was the last province to join the Trans-Canada Highway programme, and it took ten and a half years. When the other provinces signed in 1950, Quebec declined: in the wording Statistics Canada recorded at the time, because in that province's opinion the agreement did not include sufficient guarantee for the protection of the rights of the Province of Quebec.

The signature came on 27 October 1960, under a government four months old. Jean Lesage had become premier on 5 July 1960, and the autoroute that carries most of the designation across the province now carries his name — conferred by order in council on 24 February 1988 and officialised on 9 March.

The Autoroute du Souvenir section was named on 7 November 2005, for the sixtieth anniversary of the end of the Second World War, marking the courage of those who on land, at sea and in the air made the ultimate sacrifice of their lives.
zh: 魁北克是最后加入横加公路计划的省份，前后拖了十年半。1950 年其他各省签约时，魁北克拒签：按加拿大统计局当时记录的措辞，因为在该省看来，该协议对魁北克省权利的保障不够充分。
签字发生在 1960 年 10 月 27 日，当时执政的政府才成立四个月。让·勒萨日于 1960 年 7 月 5 日出任省长，而今日承载该省大部分指定路线的这条高速公路，正以他命名——1988 年 2 月 24 日由省政府法令授名，同年 3 月 9 日正式生效。
Autoroute du Souvenir 一段于 2005 年 11 月 7 日命名，适逢第二次世界大战结束六十周年，以表彰那些在陆上、海上与空中献出生命的人们的勇气。

value.en: A little over 450 km from Longueuil to Notre-Dame-des-Neiges, plus about 45 km from Rimouski to Mont-Joli, as the Commission de toponymie describes the two sections. Quebec's transport ministry publishes no consolidated route total.
value.zh: 按地名委员会对两段路身的描述：自 Longueuil 至 Notre-Dame-des-Neiges「四百五十余公里」，另有 Rimouski 至 Mont-Joli「约 45 公里」。魁北克交通部未公布全线合计里程。

figures.source: Commission de toponymie du Québec, fiche “Autoroute Jean-Lesage”, updated 7 October 2020

value.en: 162,000 vehicles a day at Lachine in Montreal in 2024, both directions; 152,000 in the provisional 2025 figures
value.zh: 2024 年蒙特利尔 Lachine 路段双向日均 162,000 辆；2025 年初步数据为 152,000 辆

figures.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec, Débit de circulation dataset, 2024 and provisional 2025
Commission de toponymie du Québec, fiche “Autoroute Jean-Lesage”

why.en: No public route-wide figure. The autoroute was built in stages from the 1960s and Quebec's transport ministry reports cost by project rather than by route; no consolidated total for A-20 has been published.
why.zh: 无全线公开数据。这条高速公路自 1960 年代分期建设，魁北克交通部按项目而非按路线核算造价，从未发布 A-20 的合计总额。

timeline.en: Quebec declines to sign a Trans-Canada Highway agreement while six other provinces sign, holding that it does not sufficiently guarantee the rights of the province.
timeline.zh: 在其他六省签约之际，魁北克拒签横加公路协议，认为它对本省权利的保障不够充分。

timeline.en: Jean Lesage becomes premier on 5 July; Quebec signs its Trans-Canada Highway agreement on 27 October, ten and a half years after the other provinces.
timeline.zh: 7 月 5 日让·勒萨日出任省长；10 月 27 日，魁北克签署横加公路协议，比其他省份晚了十年半。

timeline.en: The autoroute is named for Lesage by order in council on 24 February, officialised 9 March.
timeline.zh: 2 月 24 日，省政府法令将这条高速公路命名为勒萨日高速公路，3 月 9 日正式生效。

timeline.en: The section from Rivière-Beaudette to the Turcot interchange is named the Autoroute du Souvenir on 7 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 7 日，自 Rivière-Beaudette 至 Turcot 立交的路段被命名为 Autoroute du Souvenir。
